jobs.description: Are you eligible for Professional Client status? English Log in Platform etoro Platform English Help Log in Sign Up Download the App Search English Log in Sign Up Platform etoro Platform English Log in Platform etoro Platform Trade and Invest Markets Stocks Crypto ETFs Indices Commodities Currencies All markets → Trading Fees Market Hours & Events CFD Futures Professional Account Investment Products CopyTrader™ Smart Portfolios Recurring Investments Alpha Portfolios Why etoro AI Investing Tori Agentic Portfolio Signature Products CopyTrader™ Smart Portfolios Pro Investor Benefits eToro Club Interest on Balance Tax Report Account Protection Learn Academy Getting Started Market Insights Earnings Calendar etoro Digest Company About etoro Customer Support Media Center Careers Investor Relations Awards Risk Disclosures English Log in Sign Up Download the App Search English Log in Sign Up Platform etoro Platform Home / Trading / Professional Account Professional Account If you qualify for Professional Client status, our account for experienced traders may be for you. An etoro client who meets certain criteria can opt to become a Professional Client. This is a regulatory status available for experienced traders and financial professionals who are permitted to employ more advanced strategies in managing their portfolios. To qualify, you must be able to answer yes to at least two of the following three questions: Have you carried out transactions, in significant size, on the relevant market at an average frequency of 10 per quarter over the previous four quarters? Does the value of your investment portfolio exceed €500,000? Have you worked in the financial sector in a professional capacity for at least one year, which requires knowledge of the transactions or services envisaged? I’m Eligible I’m not Eligible Please note: Only customers registered under etoro UK (under FCA regulation) and etoro EU (under CySEC regulation) can apply for Professional Client status. Important information to note for Professional Clients: Professional Clients are not entitled to ICF Compensation. Negative balance protection is not available for professional accounts. Losses can exceed deposits. We expect professional clients to have a certain level of knowledge and understanding of the risks associated with trading complex financial products and conducting transactions. You may apply to receive Professional Client status We will be required to successfully determine your suitability before qualifying you as a Professional Client. Please proceed with your application process: Apply Now Register Here First Becoming an etoro Professional Client Increased leverage Access a higher level of leverage for all assets (see table below) Leveraged crypto trading Access leverage when trading cryptoassets Volume-based rebate High volume traders can enjoy rebates on their trades Get paid for referrals Invite friends and family to join etoro and receive a bonus Exclusive events Be our guest at invitation-only events, just for Professional Clients Instrument Pro Account Leverage FX 400 Indices 100 Commodities 100 Shares 10 Crypto 5 Apply Now Register Here First FAQ What’s the difference between a Retail Client and a Professional Client? A Retail Client is subject to more restrictions than a Professional Client but receives more protections by law. A Professional Client may be exposed to higher risk, and therefore must act with greater responsibility and accountability, but receives access to more features than a Retail Client. To understand the full legal description of client categorization, visit the etoro regulations page and refer to the “Client Categorization” section. What happens if I do not qualify for Professional Client status? You will retain your Retail Client status, which is the default status for all etoro users. Retail Clients receive access to all our trading assets and can trade both manually or via Copy Trade (subject to suitability). However, Retail Clients’ leverage is restricted. Retail Clients receive certain protections such as coverage by the Investor Compensation Fund and recourse to the Financial Ombudsman Service. Furthermore, they receive negative balance protection and margin closeout restrictions. Do I need an etoro Retail Client account before I can apply for a Professional Client account? Yes. You must first open a standard etoro account before applying for Professional Client status. If you already have an account with us, and have checked your eligibility, you can apply for Professional Client status immediately. jobs.description: Agent Portfolios: Let Your AI Agent Trade on eToro Log in Platform etoro Platform Help Log in Sign Up Download the App Search Log in Sign Up Platform etoro Platform Log in Platform etoro Platform Trade and Invest Markets Stocks Crypto ETFs Indices Commodities Currencies All markets → Trading Fees Market Hours & Events CFD Futures Professional Account Investment Products CopyTrader™ Smart Portfolios Recurring Investments Alpha Portfolios Why etoro AI Investing Tori Agentic Portfolio Signature Products CopyTrader™ Smart Portfolios Pro Investor Benefits eToro Club Interest on Balance Tax Report Account Protection Learn Academy Getting Started Market Insights Earnings Calendar etoro Digest Company About etoro Customer Support Media Center Careers Investor Relations Awards Risk Disclosures Log in Sign Up Download the App Search Log in Sign Up Platform etoro Platform Until now, automated trading strategies were the exclusive domain of hedge funds and institutions: teams of quants with proprietary infrastructure and million-dollar budgets. If you’re an individual investor who also happens to build with AI, you’ve had the skills to create something powerful but nowhere safe to run it. That changes today. We’re launching Agent Portfolios in a gradual rollout and for the first time, you can connect your own AI agent to a real trading portfolio on etoro. What is an Agent Portfolio? An Agent Portfolio is a dedicated sub-portfolio inside your etoro account, built specifically for AI-driven trading. You name it, fund it with an amount you choose, and connect your agent through a scoped API key. From there, your agent can trade on your behalf within the portfolio you’ve set up for it. You stay in control of how much capital to allocate, which agent to connect, and the boundaries it operates within. It’s the simplest way to go from “I built an AI agent” to “my AI agent is trading for me.” Here’s what you get: Your own AI trading portfolio. A separate portfolio dedicated to your agent’s strategies, distinct from your personal investments. You choose the budget. Start with as little as $200. Scale up as you gain confidence. Adjust anytime. Scoped API credentials. A dedicated API key tied to this portfolio. Connect it to whatever you’ve built: a Python script, an LLM-powered agent, a custom trading bot, an OpenClaw. What builders are already doing A developer in our beta connected an agent that monitors VIX levels via a public API. When volatility spikes above 25, the agent rotates into defensive positions. When VIX drops below 20, it re-enters equities. The entire strategy runs autonomously inside a $1,000 Agent Portfolio. Others are experimenting with: Scheduled rebalancing. Agents that check sector weightings daily and rebalance when allocation drift exceeds a threshold. Thesis-driven portfolios. Agents that maintain concentrated positions in a theme like AI infrastructure, energy transition or crypto, and adjust as prices move. Signal-reactive strategies. Agents that respond to external data feeds: earnings releases, macro indicators, sentiment scores, and execute trades within rules you define. The strategies are yours to design. The API gives your agent the ability to open positions, close positions, check balances, and manage the portfolio you’ve scoped for it. Get started in under five minutes Setting up your Agent Portfolio takes just a few steps. Choose your preferred setup path below: Path A: The Standard Setup Open Agent Portfolios (Beta) from the etoro desktop platform’s side menu. Name your portfolio, allocate your starting budget (minimum $200), and copy your API key. Give your AI agent this prompt: “Install the etoro skill from https://www.etoro.com/wp-content/uploads/agent-portfolios/SKILL.md , then follow its instructions.” Path B: The Conversational Setup Simply paste this prompt directly into your AI agent: “Install the etoro skill from https://www.etoro.com/wp-content/uploads/agent-portfolios/SKILL.md , then follow its instructions.” Your agent will guide you from there – portfolio name, investment amount, and strategy. Zero code. Zero configuration. Just a conversation. Full API documentation here 💡 Important: You need an Agent, not a Chatbot To use this flow, your AI must be able to execute commands and run API calls directly. Supported: Agents like OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Cursor. Not supported: Standard chatbots like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude.ai. These are sandboxed and cannot execute the required configuration commands. This is just the beginning Agent Portfolios are the foundation for a much bigger vision. One where every investor has access to the kind of intelligent, automated tools that were once reserved for the few. We’re starting with the builders, because you’ll show us what’s possible. We’re building in the open and we want your feedback. If you create something interesting, push the limits, or have ideas for what the API should do next, tell us. TABLE OF CONTENTS Turning On/Off and Using accessWidget What Happens When “Screen Reader Mode” is Activated Frequently asked questions about screen-reader support for websites Help make your website accessible START FREE TRIAL In short: Summarize full blog with: ChatGPT Perplexity If you’ve reached this guide, it’s likely because you encountered the “Accessibility Screen-Reader Guide, Feedback, and Issue Reporting” button on a website. This guide is for blind or low-vision individuals, focusing on utilizing accessWidget, one of accessiBe’s web accessibility tools. This guide doesn’t intend to teach you how to use your screen reader, as most users who utilize screen readers daily already possess this skill set. Here’s what you can expect from this guide: Practical tips and suggestions for visiting websites with accessWidget. Instructions on enabling or disabling accessWidget at any point. An explanation of what occurs on websites when accessWidget is active and how it impacts your screen reader. How to report issues, provide feedback, or get assistance. Turning On/Off and Using accessWidget Upon entering a website with accessWidget installed, your screen reader will announce a message, such as “Press Alt+1 (Windows) / Option+1 (MacOS) For Screen Reader Mode, Alt+0 (Windows) / Option+1 (MacOS) to Cancel” or “For screen reader mode, press the first button of the website.” The message will vary depending on your browser window size and the type of device you are using (desktop, mobile, or tablet). Here is what these messages mean: Alt+1 (Windows) / Option+1 (MacOS) Message – A chime will sound a second or two after hitting this keyboard combination, indicating you are now in screen reader mode. First Button Message – the “first button of the website” is a button labeled “Use Website In Screen-Reader Mode” and should be accessible at the very start of the webpage. This is a toggle button that you can use anytime to switch screen reader mode on or off. Both actions (alt/option+1 or using the first button) activate “Screen Reader Mode.” Before explaining what “Screen Reader Mode” entails, here are a few keyboard combinations you can use to turn this mode on and off at any time: Alt+1 (Windows) / Option+1 (MacOS) – Activates screen reader mode. Alt+8 (Windows) / Option+8 (MacOS) – Deactivates screen reader mode. Note that the page will refresh, and the website will still read the alert message and provide the screen reader mode button. Alt+0 (Windows) / Option+0 (MacOS) – Turns off screen reader mode and stops announcing its availability. This also refreshes the page. To reset the functionality and make screen reader mode available again, use Alt+0 (Windows) / Option+0 (MacOS). Alt+9 (Windows) / Option+9 (MacOS) – Opens an accessibility widget, which offers options for users with different disabilities to customize the website to their needs. This includes increasing font size, stopping animations, changing color contrasts, and more. Use the Escape key (or the close button) to close the widget after opening it. What Happens When “Screen Reader Mode” is Activated First and foremost, by enabling “Screen Reader Mode,” you WILL NOT be tracked, and your privacy will not be compromised. We do not track any user, we do not collect any data about you, and we do not share any other personal information about you with any third party for any purpose. The only information we collect is how many times accessWidget’s features have been activated; this information is not associated with any user, IP address, or anything else which might be used to identify a specific user. Furthermore, accessWidget does not make use of cookies, so even other popular trackers on websites such as Facebook or Google Analytics cannot associate you with the activation of screen reader mode. To ensure your selection is saved for your subsequent browsing sessions on this website, we use local storage instead of cookies. Technically, it is not possible to read data from local storage on any server, be it ours or a third party’s, intentionally or unintentionally. The last point on this topic is about the alert message you hear: it IS NOT a detection of your screen reader. Rather, it is an audible alert message that every website visitor receives, regardless of whether they have a screen reader or not. However, if they do not have a screen reader, they will not hear it. We do not detect screen readers. When Screen Reader Mode is activated, you will observe many changes to the website that were not present prior to activating the mode. These changes occur because the fundamental code of the website has been significantly modified to be more accessible to your screen reader. This transformation is made by adhering to WCAG guidelines and implementing changes related to usability to make the website work better for assistive technology. This process, which includes both monitoring and remediation, is ongoing and occurs on a daily basis. This ensures that even if the website undergoes changes or updates, these will become accessible almost immediately. Please note that these changes do not create a different experience or a version of the website. You will be using the exact same website but with code changes that make it more accessible. When Screen Reader Mode is activated, you can expect to observe the following modifications: Skip Links: Multiple skip links will be available as buttons at the very beginning of every page. These buttons allow you to jump to different page sections, such as the main content, the menu, or the footer. Try it in demo mode. Every account includes a free $100,000 virtual portfolio for you to practise with. Join etoro FAQ What is CFD trading? CFD trading is a method of trading the value of an underlying asset. The trader and broker enter into a contract whereby they agree to exchange the difference between the price of an underlying asset at the opening and closing of the trade. That is how the CFD gets its name, as it stands for “Contract for Difference” of price. CFD trading allows investors to leverage their capital and provides many of the benefits of trading assets such as stocks, commodities, indices and crypto without actually owning the instrument or investing large sums of capital. To learn more about CFD trading, click here. How do CFDs work? The trader chooses an asset offered as a CFD by the broker. It could be a stock, an index, a currency or any other asset to which the broker provides access. The trader opens the position and sets parameters such as whether it’s a long or short position, leverage size, invested amount (margin), stop-loss and other parameters, depending on the broker. The broker will then state what the opening price for the position is, and whether or not additional fees (such as overnight fees) are involved. The position is opened and remains open until either the trader decides to close it or it is closed by an automatic command, such as reaching a Stop-Loss or Take Profit point or the expiry of the contract. If the position closes in profit, the broker pays the trader for the difference. If it closes at a loss, the trader pays the broker for the difference. To learn more about how CFDs work, click here. What does “underlying asset” mean? Some investment products, including CFDs, are derived from other financial assets. Underlying asset refers to the real financial asset — for example, the actual share of ownership in a stock, or a barrel of oil — on which the financial derivative is based. It is the value of the underlying asset that drives the value of the financial derivative. An underlying asset can be physically owned; a CFD cannot. Which assets can I trade as CFDs? etoro offers CFD trading with currencies, commodities, indices, stocks, and cryptoassets (where available). What is leveraged trading? Sometimes traders may wish to gain a certain level of market exposure with minimal equity as part of their investment strategy. Trading with leverage means using capital which is a fraction of the position opened. Leverage is applied in multiples of the capital invested by the trader, for example 2x, 5x, or higher. Leverage may be applied to both buy (long) and short (sell) positions. For illustration purposes only.
